title: A work order tier change leaves Part Sales on their tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Pick tier A.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Create a new Part Sale for customer A.
  7. Add a category A part to the Part Sale at a cost of $20.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 3:

  • The picker lists tier A.

Step 4:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A.

Step 5:

  • The card shows Work Order Tier tier A and Part Sales Tier 1 · Default.

Step 6:

  • The Part Sale opens for customer A.

Step 7:

  • The part sells at $30.00 ($20.00 × 1.50 = $30.00, Default).
  • It is not priced at tier A's $24.00.
